span.div:
1. Cycle detected: P1 - P2 - P3 - P1
2. Select victim: P3 (holds 1 lock, shortest
execution time)
3. Abort P3: rollback transaction, release its
locks
4. Wait-for graph resolves:
P1 waits for P2 (P3 no longer holds locks)
P2 acquires P3's lock, completes, releases
for P1
5. P3 retries its operation

or the process with the shortest execution time.
